I replied to Marcus in #north-team's thread on his message. I took "tomorrow" as Thursday 15 October, going by the simulation clock (2026-10-14). The reply acknowledges that he'll be on the road and reachable on mobile, and offers to pick things up while he's away, such as a calendar hold or a channel summary.

He didn't ask for anything specific, so I didn't take any other action.
